source_refs.note: Unnumbered heading Identifying Equivalent Logical Expressions under 2.6, as printed (PDF 30, printed 26).

blocks.text: Equivalent logical expressions are identified using truth tables. Each expression is tested for all possible truth values. If the results match in every case, they are equivalent. Logical laws can also help identify equivalence. These laws simplify expressions. Identifying equivalence helps reduce complex expressions.
